added: Import ▸ Your own text or Markdown file: bring in dances you typed up as notes in a .txt or .md file. Each heading, or each title after a blank line, starts a dance, and Map labels lets you change where dances start if the app guessed wrong; Label: value lines are a dance's details and one figure per line its figures. Map labels also lets you choose what each label holds, and a label no field takes is kept in the calling notes with its name.

readTextDocument (with an optional danceLevel), detectTextDocumentDanceLevel, textDocumentHeadingLevels, textDocumentToCsv, textDocumentDefaultColumns and decodeTextDocumentBytes: read a text or Markdown file of dances into the spreadsheet import's columns, under the spreadsheet's caps (TextDocumentReadException).
CsvColumnMapping.labelledNotes: a column kept in the calling notes as Label: value.
splitLabelLine and splitByLine: the Label: value and by Name line readers, shared with the Caller's Companion text adapter.
